decision.title: XPath and XQuery conformance sweep: 's leftovers and fresh clusters (packet )
decision.summary: The XPath and XQuery sweep adds library context value types, fn:string(.) parameter defaults, cast namespaces of a place, a set_element_identity tree builder operation for is-id, and declines static typing by default.

body.p: , after , , , , , , . No IR expression kind added; one public header changed additively (tree.h, below).

item.p: Start (release driver, whole runs at d9ff5ed): XP40 32,716 passed (32 wrong-error), 55 failed; XQ40 46,017 (53), 191 failed. Clusters by root cause: 's open list (context value types of library modules 4, string-length/normalize-space 2, QName casts in direct constructors 5, is-id of list and union elements 6, use-xsi-schema-location 0 failing cases); in-scope namespaces of nested direct constructors 5; static checks of named item types, function types, EQNames and PI targets 12; casts from strings to unions 1; variable cycles found statically 2 (+2 wrong errors); xs:T#0 and function-lookup 1; partial-application names 3; and the kept groups (assert-xml whitespace about 25, XML 1.1 query lexing 13 (), recordTypeDecl/ paths 5, EXPath Binary's types, staticTyping).

Library context value types (XQuery 4.0, 5.17): the context global takes the main module's type (item()* without one) and each library declaration adds a global of name 0 without initializer, whose type the evaluator matches, without coercion, when it binds or computes the context global (XPTY0004).

fn:string(.) defaults (F&O 4.0, 5.3.11, 5.3.12): sxml_function_parameter.defaults_to_string_value (with SXML_PARAMETER_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_VALUE): static calls pass fn:string(.), named references capture it, fn:function-lookup binds it through fn:string's row; an explicit argument is xs:anyAtomicType?.

Namespaces of a place ( extended): a cast to a namespace-sensitive type records, in XQuery and XSLT, the statically known namespaces of its place (sxml_ir_cast.namespace_bindings; direct constructors' declarations, XSLT elements' namespaces); XSLT's general comparisons record them for xs:untypedAtomic against xs:QName (sxml_ir_binary.namespace_bindings). Empty lists mean the running module's (sxml_dynamic_context_get_static_namespaces), now also for general comparisons. Not covered: XSLT's per-element default collation (choose-0107, collations-0121 to -0124), another static property.

is-id of list and union elements (XDM 4.0, 7.5.2.4): an additive optional tree builder operation, set_element_identity (include/sxml/tree.h, after the freeze as allows, with sxml_element_identity_event), replaces dm:is-id and dm:is-idrefs of the open element after its content. The schema validator sends it for an element of simple content when its typed value's marks differ from those the start event had (a list of xs:ID of length one, a union whose value is an xs:ID or xs:IDREF); the arena tree and the validator's recorder implement it, other builders leave it NULL and keep the start event's values. This replaces 's "no later mark is possible".

Nested direct constructors (XQuery 4.0, 4.12.4): a direct element constructor in another's content has only its own in-scope namespaces (construction flag OWN_NAMESPACES; its declared list already holds the enclosing declarations); elements of enclosed expressions are copies and inherit as before (Constr-inscope-24 to -26).
Variable cycles (5.16): the prolog's dependency walk no longer raises XQDY0054 for a cycle of its static superset; the evaluator raises it for a global being computed ().

Smaller fixes: document-node(N) and document-node(N1|N2) (a choice of document tests); XQST0039 for repeated parameter names in function types; XQST0070 and XPST0154 for EQNames; NCName PI targets (XPTY0004); fn:string of nested JNodes; computed names' collapsed URIs; map:build's lower-arity duplicates functions (function coercion); XQST0045, XQST0146, XQST0034 and XQST0140 for named item types; casts of strings to unions from their text (F&O 23.3.7); a general comparison's QName cast; xs:T#0 through fn:function-lookup; catch-clause variables referenced with a constructor's prefix; partial applications named by their native row; namespace-uri-for-prefix's (xs:NCName | enum(''))? parameter.

Measured (release driver, whole runs at 8669abe, which has 4.25's, 4.26's and cli-2's commits too, about eight cases of these numbers): XP40 32,731 passed (30 wrong-error), 40 failed; XQ40 46,070 (49), 138 failed; 0 errors; XT40 12,192 passed, 326 failed; no case lost at any step, case by case. CONFORMANCE.md is not regenerated: another packet has uncommitted changes in it.

Static typing (the optional staticTyping feature; 104 XQ40 and 48 XP40 cases, almost all expecting a static XPTY0004, a few XPST0005): XQuery 4.0 has dropped the feature and its appendix (6, "Changes in 4.0", PR 1344), so the rules are XQuery 3.1's and the Formal Semantics'. It would take one new IR pass after lowering that infers a static sequence type for every expression kind (about 100 kinds, with the registry's subtype tests and occurrence arithmetic), pessimistic checks at calls, operators, paths and casts, node-kind and schema-type inference for axis steps, and the XQuery Update rules (27 cases): estimated 4,000 to 6,000 lines in two or three packets, behind an option off by default, since it rejects queries that run correctly. Proposed default: do not implement; the cases stay not run.

Not done: XQuery's XML 1.1 lexing (, 13 cases); the whitespace-only assert-xml cases; JNode name tests Q{}N against NCName (frozen sxml_name_test; JAxes-292, PathExpr-J-157); fn:load-xquery-module in XPath (needs an optional feature like xslt-transform: header change); runtime constructors of named item types for fn:function-lookup (itemTypeDecl-058); xml:id under lax validation without the xml namespace schema (fo-test-fn-id-001 and three more) and IDREF checks on element roots (2, ); deep-equal of partial applications (4); the singletons listed in the runs (serialization adaptive and XML method 13, load-xquery-module 9, fn:transform 3, xml-to-json 4, xsd-validator 3, collations of group/order by 2).
